description: Veteran of the one attempt anyone made on the cave. He came back alone, buys rounds for those who did not, and says only that it asked politely.
lore: What the whole country knows about him fits in [[lore/the_hole_under_the_mountain|one chapter]]: the summer morning, the best the fires had, the evening he came back out alone, unhollowed, unmarked, and the three words every asker since has been paid. This record will not improve on it. What it can add is the shape of his evenings. He buys rounds for people who are not there to drink them, and the ritual has an order: the same cups, the same places at the table, filled and left standing, and his own drunk last, facing the door.

People read the silence as a wound and grant it the wide berth wounds get. [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] tested it. She asked him nothing about the inside — only about the ones who went in — and he talked until the candles were done: names, trades, who owed whom, who sang badly on the walk east, freely and warmly and in order. His account of that morning is the fullest thing in [[lore/the_chronicle|the Chronicle]], and it stops at the mouth of the cave like a cut rope. A wound does not choose its edges that cleanly. A promise does.

What was promised, and to whom, is nowhere in this book, because he has kept it out of every book, and pays for the keeping in public and in small change: the rounds he cannot afford, the [[items/hollow_black_soulstone|eastern stone]] sold under its price the same evening it was paid to him, the seat that faces the door. He could go on — he is as whole as the day he walked out, which is its own uncomfortable fact — and he stays, and keeps the cups filled, and lets everyone call it grief, because the truth has no polite shape: silence that is kept was silence given to someone, and Hearn is good for his debts.
gm_notes: The silence is a PROMISE, not trauma — that is the whole record — and the promisee is deliberately unwritten even at GM level: resolving to whom (one of the fallen, or the thing itself) is a root-adjacent act beside B7/B12 and must not happen in leaf text. Agrees with the_hole_under_the_mountain (three words, the rounds) and hollow_black_soulstone (the under-price sale, made without a word). New leaf-canon: the ordered cup ritual, Bettany's names interview, his wholeness as an uncomfortable fact. 'It asked politely' is the only shipped clue that something was asked — and therefore possibly granted.
